glossary.definition: (4) As used in division (B) of this section, "regional traffic management system" means an integrated, high-technology system to provide remote control center surveillance and monitoring of the regional freeways and main arterial routes in order to reduce and eliminate major backups and delays to motorists in the area.
glossary.source_title: Section 5501.44 - Cooperative agreements for repair of bridges and regional traffic management systems.
